title: Witnesses split up and reassigned

tellings.quote:
what did they do with
Terry and Toby split them reassign them
you can't talk to each other what what
do they do with with Mario woods and
Michael Johnson same thing

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says the US military deals with witnesses to strange events by splitting them up and reassigning them so they "can't talk to each other." He gives the examples of two men he calls Terry and Toby, and of Mario Woods and Michael Johnson, and says the "same thing" happened to both pairs. He tells it from his own knowledge without naming a source, and it would mean the military deliberately keeps witnesses from comparing stories.
